name: Russia
traditionNote: A codified civil-law system built on comprehensive federal codes, so the starting point is almost always the current consolidated text of a code or federal law rather than a line of cases.
summary: Federal law is made by the Federal Assembly (State Duma plus Federation Council), signed by the President, and supplemented by presidential decrees, Government resolutions and registered acts of federal executive agencies. Since the Official Internet Portal of Legal Information (pravo.gov.ru) was given legal force as a publication channel in 2011, its publication section at publication.pravo.gov.ru is the first and authoritative official publication of federal acts; the print outlets Rossiyskaya Gazeta and Sobranie zakonodatelstva RF remain official publication sources alongside it. Federal laws generally enter into force ten days after official publication unless the act sets another date, and presidential and Government normative acts generally after seven days. The authentic text is the Russian-language text as officially published; the scanned/signed PDF carried on the publication portal, with its unique official publication number, is what settles disputes about wording. The Constitution of 12 December 1993 has been amended several times, most substantially by the package approved in the all-Russian vote of 1 July 2020 and republished by presidential decree of 3 July 2020.
hierarchy: Constitution of the Russian Federation (1993, as amended)
Laws of the Russian Federation on amendment to the Constitution
Decrees and orders of the President (ukazy, rasporyazheniya)
Resolutions and orders of the Government (postanovleniya, rasporyazheniya)
Acts of federal executive agencies registered with the Ministry of Justice
Constitutions/charters and laws of the federal subjects

gazette.name: Ofitsialnoe opublikovanie pravovykh aktov (publication.pravo.gov.ru)
gazette.en: Official Publication of Legal Acts, Official Internet Portal of Legal Information
gazette.authority: Federalnaya sluzhba okhrany Rossiyskoy Federatsii (FSO) - state legal information system; registered network publication FS77-47467
gazette.coverage: Official electronic publication from 2011 to present; the portal's databanks reach back much further
gazette.desc: The publication of record. Federal constitutional laws, federal laws, laws on amendment to the Constitution, acts of both chambers, presidential decrees and orders, Government acts, registered acts of federal executive agencies, Constitutional Court rulings, laws of the federal subjects, international treaties in force and UN Security Council resolutions all appear here on the day they are officially published, each with an official publication number.
gazette.howto: Use POISK (search) to filter by issuing body, document type, number and date range, or KALENDAR OPUBLIKOVANIYA to browse everything published on a given day; the daily blocks (documents/daily?block=president, ?block=government, ?block=court, ?block=international, ?block=subjects) give a fast per-branch view. Each hit opens the signed PDF plus its publication number.
gazette.note: The site is served over plain HTTP only; https://publication.pravo.gov.ru does not answer at all, so use the http:// form. Over HTTP the site, its daily/weekly/monthly blocks and the RSS feed all respond normally from outside Russia.

constitution.name: Konstitutsiya Rossiyskoy Federatsii
constitution.coverage: Adopted 12 December 1993; consolidated text incorporating the amendments approved in the all-Russian vote of 1 July 2020 and the subsequent amendment laws
constitution.desc: The official consolidated text of the Constitution, hosted on the portal designated by the presidential decree of 3 July 2020 on the official publication of the Constitution with its amendments. The page also lists every amending instrument, from the 2008 laws through 30 December 2008 No. 6/7-FKZ, 5 February 2014 No. 2-FKZ, 21 July 2014 No. 11-FKZ, 14 March 2020 No. 1-FKZ and 4 October 2022 Nos. 5-8-FKZ.
constitution.howto: Open the page and read the text by section and chapter; the amendment laws are linked individually if you need to see which change came from which instrument. The presidential decree of 5 October 2022 No. 710 on republishing the text is linked from the same page.
constitution.note: The Kremlin's constitution.kremlin.ru page carries the same text and an optical PDF copy but expressly points to pravo.gov.ru as the official placement.

sources.name: Teksty pravovykh aktov s vnesennymi izmeneniyami
sources.native: Тексты правовых актов с внесенными изменениями
sources.en: Legal acts with amendments incorporated (consolidated texts)
sources.coverage: Federal acts maintained in consolidated form, updated as amendments are published
sources.desc: The state's own consolidation service: the current in-force text of an act with all amendments already merged in. This is the official answer to 'what does the law say today', as opposed to the publication portal which shows each act exactly as enacted.
sources.howto: Search by act type, number and date or by words in the title, then open the consolidated version; the interface is JavaScript-driven, so it needs a real browser rather than a plain fetch.
sources.note: Consolidation is an editorial service of the portal; where a dispute turns on exact wording the as-published text on publication.pravo.gov.ru governs.

sources.name: Integrirovannyy bank "Zakonodatelstvo Rossii"
sources.coverage: Federal legislation plus separate normative-act banks for every federal subject; a separate module covers the Svod zakonov of the Russian Empire
sources.desc: The deepest free official retrieval system on the portal. Its advanced search lets you tick federal legislation, any combination of regional databanks (BPA of each oblast, kray, republic and federal city), or all of them at once, which nothing else on the official side does in one query.
sources.howto: On the advanced-search page (Podklyuchenie BPA) tick the databanks you want in the tree - Federalnoe zakonodatelstvo and/or the regional BPA grouped by federal district - then fill in document type, number, date and free text; results link through to full texts. The Svod zakonov of the Russian Empire is a separate module at pravo.gov.ru/proxy/ips/?empire, and a newer test-mode interface runs at http://ips.pravo.gov.ru.
sources.note: The interface is dated, frame-based and served in windows-1251 over plain HTTP; deep links into results are fragile, so bookmark the search entry point rather than a result. The test-mode host ips.pravo.gov.ru answers on HTTP only - its HTTPS port does not respond.

sources.name: Sobranie zakonodatelstva Rossiyskoy Federatsii
sources.en: Collection of Legislation of the Russian Federation
sources.coverage: The weekly official compilation, issue by issue
sources.desc: The electronic edition of the weekly official compilation that is still the standard citation form for Russian federal acts (SZ RF, year, issue number, item number). Go here when you have or need an SZ RF citation rather than a portal publication number.
sources.howto: Use the search panel to set Izdanie (edition), God (year), Vypusk (issue), Data prinyatiya (adoption date), Nomer (act number), Statya (item number) or Nazvanie (title), then Nayti; results resolve to the published item. The interface is JavaScript-driven, so it needs a real browser rather than a plain fetch.
sources.note: The same application is mirrored at https://www.szrf.ru; the szrf.pravo.gov.ru host is the one linked from the official portal's own footer as Ofitsialnoe izdanie 'Sobranie zakonodatelstva Rossiyskoy Federatsii'.

sources.name: SOZD - Sistema obespecheniya zakonodatelnoy deyatelnosti
sources.en: Legislative Activity Support System (State Duma bill tracker)
sources.authority: Gosudarstvennaya Duma Federalnogo Sobraniya Rossiyskoy Federatsii
sources.coverage: Bills and draft resolutions across convocations, with full procedural file
sources.desc: The bill-by-bill record: sponsor, explanatory note, committee opinions, financial-economic justification, every reading, amendment tables, and the final federal law number. This is where you reconstruct why a provision reads the way it does.
sources.howto: Enter at /oz for bills or /oz/p for draft resolutions and filter by convocation, sponsor, committee or subject; the Duma's own legislative-activity page also links standing lists such as federal laws signed by the President this session.
sources.note: The host resolves but silently drops connections from networks outside Russia, so it will look dead from abroad even though it is live: duma.gov.ru itself answers normally and its lawmaking page links sozd.duma.gov.ru/oz, /oz/p, /calendar/ and /stat/perechnisub, which is how the entry points above were confirmed.

sources.name: Bank dokumentov Prezidenta Rossii
sources.en: Document bank of the President of Russia
sources.coverage: Presidential decrees and orders, plus federal laws and codes as signed, in a browsable chronological bank
sources.desc: The President's own searchable bank of signed instruments. Faster to browse chronologically than the publication portal when you know roughly when a decree was signed but not its number.
sources.howto: Use the document search box to filter by document type (Ukaz, Rasporyazhenie, Federalnyy zakon, Federalnyy konstitutsionnyy zakon, Kodeks), number, title text and date, or scroll the bank by date.
sources.note: The site itself points to pravo.gov.ru as the official legal-information portal; treat this bank as a convenience copy.

sources.name: Dokumenty Pravitelstva Rossii
sources.en: Documents of the Government of Russia
sources.coverage: Government resolutions and orders, with explanatory summaries
sources.desc: Government resolutions (postanovleniya) and orders (rasporyazheniya) - the layer of subordinate legislation that actually implements most federal statutes - together with plain-language notes explaining what each one does.
sources.howto: Use the document search to filter by document type, number, title/text and signing date, or browse the thematic sections; each entry links the act plus a summary of its effect.
sources.note: An English section exists but covers only selected items and summaries, not the operative texts.

sources.name: Federalnyy portal proektov normativnykh pravovykh aktov
sources.native: Федеральный портал проектов нормативных правовых актов
sources.en: Federal portal for draft normative legal acts
sources.coverage: Draft acts of federal executive agencies undergoing public consultation and regulatory impact assessment
sources.desc: Where subordinate legislation is visible before it exists: draft decrees, resolutions and agency orders posted for public discussion, with impact assessments and the record of comments received.
sources.howto: Search by developer agency, stage or keyword, or use the advanced draft search; each draft page shows its consultation window, the text, and the assessment outcome.
sources.note: Drafts here are not law: they frequently change before adoption and some lapse entirely. The adopted text appears on the publication portal.

sources.name: Normativnye pravovye akty v Rossiyskoy Federatsii
sources.native: Нормативные правовые акты в Российской Федерации
sources.en: Normative Legal Acts in the Russian Federation (Ministry of Justice registers)
sources.coverage: Federal legislation; state register of federal executive agency acts; federal register of acts of the federal subjects; municipal charters and municipal acts; USSR and RSFSR legislation
sources.desc: The Ministry of Justice's register portal, and the single best official entry point for law below the federal statute line: registered ministry orders, the federal register of regional normative acts, the register of municipal charters, and the archive of Soviet-era acts.
sources.howto: Choose the databank you need from the front page (Federalnoe zakonodatelstvo, NPA federalnykh organov ispolnitelnoy vlasti, NPA subyektov RF, Ustavy munitsipalnykh obrazovaniy, Zakonodatelstvo SSSR i RSFSR), then search by issuing body, number, date or title.
sources.note: Registers record the act and its registration data; for the operative published text follow through to the publication portal or the issuing body.

sources.name: Dokumenty Verkhovnogo Suda Rossiyskoy Federatsii
sources.en: Documents of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation
sources.coverage: Plenum resolutions, Presidium resolutions, periodic practice reviews, judicial statistics, international practice, the Court's Bulletin, and archived Supreme Arbitrazh Court documents
sources.desc: Resolutions of the Plenum and the quarterly Obzory sudebnoy praktiki are how Russian law is actually harmonised in practice: lower courts follow them closely, so they function as the operative gloss on statutory text.
sources.howto: Pick a tab (Postanovleniya Plenuma, Postanovleniya Prezidiuma, Obzory, Sudebnaya statistika, Mezhdunarodnaya praktika, Byulleten, Dokumenty VAS RF) or open Rasshirennyy poisk and filter by Kategoriya and publication period/year.

sources.name: Informatsiya po delam i zhalobam - Verkhovnyy Sud RF
sources.native: Информация по делам и жалобам — Верховный Суд РФ
sources.en: Case and appeal search, Supreme Court of the Russian Federation
sources.coverage: Just over 6.1 million cases and appeals as of August 2026, across criminal, civil, administrative, administrative-offence, economic and disciplinary proceedings at every Supreme Court instance
sources.desc: The Supreme Court's own case database, reached through the Elektronnaya spravochnaya section, with a separate tab for the texts of judicial acts and one for challenges to normative legal acts - the route to the Court's decisions striking down or upholding regulations.
sources.howto: Filter by Data postupleniya or Data rassmotreniya, Nomer dela / zhaloby, Vid sudoproizvodstva and Instantsiya, or use Poisk po FIO (naimenovaniyu) for a party name; the sibling tabs are Teksty sudebnykh aktov for full decision texts, Spiski del k slushaniyu for hearing lists and Obzhalovanie normativnykh pravovykh aktov for challenges to regulations.
sources.note: Subscribing to case updates requires a portal account; searching does not.

sources.name: Konstitutsionnyy Sud Rossiyskoy Federatsii
sources.en: Constitutional Court of the Russian Federation
sources.coverage: Postanovleniya, opredeleniya and other decisions of the Court
sources.desc: The Court that decides whether a statute conforms to the Constitution; its postanovleniya can invalidate a provision outright or bind courts to a particular reading of it, which makes them a mandatory check on any contested norm.
sources.howto: From outside Russia the practical route is the official publication portal, whose court block is labelled Konstitutsionnyy sud precisely because Constitutional Court postanovleniya are an official-publication category: http://publication.pravo.gov.ru/documents/daily?block=court, with weekly and monthly variants of the same path. On the Court's own site, from within Russia, the decisions section filters by decision type, year and number.
sources.note: Verified alive but unreachable from abroad: ksrf.ru resolves to 95.173.151.218 and then times out on both ports from non-Russian networks, so it will look dead from outside. Confirmed real and official by the links to it from the Supreme Court's site (http://www.ksrf.ru, in Vazhnye ssylki) and from government.ru's institutions block (http://ksrf.ru/ru/Pages/default.aspx, labelled KSRF.RU). Use the publication-portal route as the fallback.

sources.name: GAS RF "Pravosudie"
sources.en: State Automated System of the Russian Federation "Justice"
sources.authority: Sudebnyy departament pri Verkhovnom Sude Rossiyskoy Federatsii
sources.coverage: Federal courts of general jurisdiction and justice-of-the-peace districts nationwide
sources.desc: The umbrella system for courts of general jurisdiction: it routes you to each individual court's site, where dockets, hearing lists and published decision texts live, plus the justice-of-the-peace districts that handle most minor matters.
sources.howto: From the front page follow Federalnye sudy obshchey yurisdiktsii or Uchastki mirovykh sudey to reach the court that heard the case, then use that court's own case-search module by case number, party or date.
sources.note: Coverage and search quality vary sharply between individual courts, and published texts are depersonalised. The .ru domain is not a government domain, but sudrf.ru is the official GAS 'Pravosudie' host of the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court and is linked as such from vsrf.ru.

sources.name: Kartoteka arbitrazhnykh del
sources.en: Case file index of the arbitrazh (commercial) courts
sources.authority: Sistema arbitrazhnykh sudov RF / servis "Elektronnoe pravosudie"
sources.coverage: All arbitrazh courts - first instance, the twenty-one appellate courts, ten cassation districts, the Supreme Court, and the historical Supreme Arbitrazh Court
sources.desc: The best-organised case database in the country: every commercial dispute with its full chronology and the PDF of each judicial act at each instance. If the question is commercial, corporate, tax, insolvency or contractual, start here rather than with the courts of general jurisdiction.
sources.howto: Use Filtr del to filter by Uchastnik dela (istets, otvetchik, trete litso, inoe litso), Sudya, Sud and case number; open a case to get its complete document chain in date order. The header carries the companion services of the Elektronnoe pravosudie suite: Strazh, Bank resheniy, Kalendar, Pereryvy, Moy Arbitr for e-filing and Proverka EP.
sources.note: The docket data is the record; it is not an edited law report, so nothing here is headnoted or flagged as superseded. The .ru domain is not a government domain, but arbitr.ru is the official domain of the federal arbitrazh court system and is linked as Federalnye arbitrazhnye sudy from vsrf.ru, which is what supports the official flag.

sources.name: KonsultantPlyus
sources.coverage: Federal and regional legislation, court practice, agency clarifications, forms and commentary; the publisher cites a base of hundreds of millions of documents
sources.desc: The commercial system most Russian lawyers and accountants actually use: consolidated texts with redlines between versions, links from every article to the cases and agency letters applying it, and editorial commentary. Its free web layer carries the codes and major statutes in full.
sources.howto: For a code or major statute use the free document pages (e.g. /popular/ for the codes, or a document URL such as /document/cons_doc_LAW_28399/ for the Constitution); the full search, version comparison and practice links require a subscription or a session on the non-commercial evening/weekend internet version.
sources.note: Private and editorially consolidated. Convenient and reliable in practice, but it is not the official text and carries no official status.

sources.name: GARANT
sources.coverage: Federal and regional legislation, court practice, forms and commentary, with a free web layer over the principal acts
sources.desc: The other dominant commercial system, and the one many researchers prefer for its annotated act pages - each article carries cross-references, amendment history and links to the practice applying it. Its free base layer covers the Constitution, codes and major federal laws.
sources.howto: Search from the base.garant.ru front page by act title or number, or go straight to a known act's stable numeric path (the Constitution sits at /10103000/); use the TEKST DOKUMENTA / ANNOTATSIYA tabs to move between the text and its editorial apparatus.
sources.note: Private and editorially consolidated; full functionality and much of the case-law layer sit behind a subscription.

sources.name: Constitution of the Russian Federation (English text, constitution.ru)
sources.authority: "Garant-Internet" (garweb.ru), the web arm of the private Garant group - the copyright line on the page reads (c) "Garant-Internet", 2001
sources.coverage: The 1993 Constitution in English, French and German alongside the Russian text
sources.desc: The most widely circulated English rendering of the Constitution, article by article and downloadable. Useful for orientation when you cannot read the Russian text, and nothing more than that.
sources.howto: Navigate by chapter from the contents page; the alphabetical index across the top jumps to subject entries.
sources.note: Significantly out of date. The text carries the 2008 amendments (article 81 already reads six years) and the 2014 article 65 additions (Crimea and Sevastopol are listed), but stops there: Chapter 3 still runs as articles 65-79, the 2020 additions such as articles 67.1, 75.1, 79.1, 92.1 and 103.1 are missing, article 81(3) still reads 'two terms running', and the 2022 article 65 changes are absent. There is no official English version of the Constitution; the authentic text is the Russian one on pravo.gov.ru.

findLaw.task: Find the current in-force text of a federal law or code
findLaw.steps: Search actual.pravo.gov.ru by act type, number and date, or by words in the title, and open the version with amendments incorporated. If you need the same text with cross-references and amendment redlines, the free layers of ConsultantPlus and Garant carry all the codes.
findLaw.source: Teksty pravovykh aktov s vnesennymi izmeneniyami (pravo.gov.ru)

findLaw.task: Check what was officially published, or find a specific amending act as enacted
findLaw.steps: Open the POISK tab on publication.pravo.gov.ru and filter by issuing body, document type, number and date range; or use KALENDAR OPUBLIKOVANIYA to see everything published on a given day. Each result gives the signed PDF and its official publication number, which is what fixes the date of publication and therefore the entry-into-force clock.

findLaw.task: See why a provision was amended and follow a bill through parliament
findLaw.steps: Search SOZD for the bill by number, sponsor or subject and open its card: the explanatory note, committee opinions, amendment tables and each reading are all attached, ending in the federal law number it became.

findLaw.task: Find court decisions on how a provision is applied
findLaw.steps: For commercial, tax, corporate and insolvency matters search kad.arbitr.ru by party, court or case number and read the document chain up the instances. For criminal, civil and administrative matters go through sudrf.ru to the specific court's own case search. Then check whether the Supreme Court has issued a Plenum resolution or practice review on the point.
findLaw.source: Kartoteka arbitrazhnykh del / GAS RF Pravosudie / Verkhovnyy Sud RF

findLaw.task: Check whether a statutory provision has been ruled unconstitutional
findLaw.steps: Search the Constitutional Court's decisions section by year and number; if the Court's own site is unreachable, pull the same rulings from the official publication portal's court block, which carries Constitutional Court postanovleniya and opredeleniya as an official-publication category.
findLaw.source: Konstitutsionnyy Sud RF / Ofitsialnoe opublikovanie pravovykh aktov

findLaw.task: Find subordinate legislation: a Government resolution or a ministry order
findLaw.steps: For Government acts search government.ru/docs by type, number and signing date. For acts of federal executive agencies use the state register on pravo.minjust.ru, which shows the Ministry of Justice registration data an agency act needs to be enforceable; for a rule still in draft, check regulation.gov.ru.
findLaw.source: Normativnye pravovye akty v RF (Minjust) / Pravitelstvo Rossii

findLaw.task: Find the law of a federal subject (republic, kray, oblast, federal city) or a municipality
findLaw.steps: Use the federal register of acts of the federal subjects and the municipal registers on pravo.minjust.ru, or tick the individual regional databanks (BPA) in the advanced search of the Zakonodatelstvo Rossii integrated bank to search federal and regional law in one query. Regional acts are also published in the subjects block of the official publication portal.

subnational: Russia is a federation, and its eighty-plus federal subjects each have their own constitution or charter, their own legislature and their own body of regional law, valid only within the subject and subordinate to federal law in the areas the Constitution reserves to the federation. Regional acts are officially published in each subject's own gazette and simultaneously in the subjects block of publication.pravo.gov.ru, and they are entered in the federal register of regional normative acts maintained by the Ministry of Justice at pravo.minjust.ru. The Zakonodatelstvo Rossii integrated bank exposes a separate searchable databank for each subject, grouped by federal district, which is the fastest way to search several regions at once. Below that sit municipal charters and municipal normative acts, held in their own Ministry of Justice registers.
caveats: Only the Russian text is authentic; there is no official English version of the Constitution or of any federal law, and the widely circulated English constitution text at constitution.ru is a private Garant-Internet page that predates the 2020 amendments entirely. Distinguish as-published from consolidated text: publication.pravo.gov.ru carries each act exactly as enacted with its official publication number, while actual.pravo.gov.ru, ConsultantPlus and Garant present editorially merged current texts that are convenient but carry no official status. ConsultantPlus and Garant are private commercial publishers, not government bodies, however universal they are in Russian practice, and their deeper functions sit behind subscriptions. Two official hosts here - ksrf.ru (Constitutional Court) and sozd.duma.gov.ru - resolve in DNS but time out from networks outside Russia, and separately the pravo.gov.ru family is served over plain HTTP only, with the HTTPS ports of publication.pravo.gov.ru and ips.pravo.gov.ru simply not answering. Neither is evidence that a source is defunct: both blocked hosts were confirmed live in August 2026 through the links to them from government.ru, vsrf.ru and duma.gov.ru. Finally, an act of a federal executive agency that has not been registered with the Ministry of Justice and officially published generally cannot be relied on against private parties, so check the register entry as well as the text.
